args:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,sys,time
data=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
assert len(data)==4096 and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2]
effect=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);release=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
fd=os.open(effect,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_APPEND|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
try:assert os.write(fd,b'EXECUTED\n')==9;os.fsync(fd)
finally:os.close(fd)
fd=os.open(effect.parent,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
try:os.fsync(fd)
finally:os.close(fd)
fd=os.open(effect.with_name(effect.name+'.ready'),os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
try:assert os.write(fd,b'READY\n')==6;os.fsync(fd)
finally:os.close(fd)
print('BEGIN',flush=True)
print('RECOVERY-STDERR',file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
deadline=time.monotonic()+75
while not release.exists():
    if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise SystemExit(81)
    time.sleep(.05)
assert release.read_bytes()==b'RELEASE\n'
print('END '+hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),flush=True)
